description: Generate a custom 300 DPI printable QR photo sharing sign and return direct print-ready links (interactive studio URL, live Vector SVG URL, 1-Up and 4-Up printable sheet URLs, encoded QR target URL, and optional inline SVG). Supports all 47 templates (including Plett Rage & Matric Rage), 8 themes, 5 frames (classic, arch, botanical, filmstrip, minimal), 5 sizes, 5 languages, custom monograms, and live Event PIN verification. When to use: Call this tool when you specifically need to execute 'generate_printable_qr_sign' on GuestDrop Event Photo Album (guestdropalbum.com). Do NOT use this tool when another specialized tool fits better (use 'get_pricing_and_packages' or 'calculate_event_cost' or 'recommend_scavenger_quests' for their respective operations). Parameters: occasion_slug (optional), headline (optional), kicker (optional), prompt (optional), date_line (optional), event_code (optional), theme (optional), frame_style (optional), print_format (optional), lang (optional), qr_style (optional), center_badge (optional), monogram (optional), accent_color (optional), show_steps (optional), show_footer (optional), crop_marks (optional), include_svg (optional). Behavior & Side Effects: Strictly read-only, idempotent query with zero state mutation; public unauthenticated access allowed; rate-limited to 60 requests/min per IP. Returns: Structured JSON object containing status, matched records or computed metrics, and canonical action URLs.

accent_color.description: Optional 6-digit hex color override for accent ink (e.g. '#4F46E5').

center_badge.description: Optional center QR medallion (none, monogram initials, or vector camera).

crop_marks.description: Include corner print trim marks for guillotine cutting (defaults to false).

date_line.description: Optional subtitle or date line below the QR code.

event_code.description: Optional 6 to 8 digit GuestDrop Event PIN to bake directly into the QR code and display on the sign.

frame_style.description: Architectural border style (classic, arch, botanical, filmstrip, or minimal). [Optional: omit to use server default filter].

headline.description: Custom main headline on the sign (e.g. 'Sarah & James', 'Mieke Turns 50'). Defaults to localized template headline or verified Event PIN name.

include_svg.description: When true, includes raw print-ready Vector <svg> markup directly in the response (defaults to false).

kicker.description: Optional top uppercase callout line above the headline.

lang.description: Sign language code (en, es, pt, fr, or it). [Optional: omit to use server default filter].

monogram.description: Up to 4 characters for center monogram when center_badge is 'monogram' (e.g. 'S&J'). [Optional: omit to use server default filter].

occasion_slug.description: Occasion template slug from list_qr_sign_templates (defaults to 'wedding-photo-qr-code-sign').

print_format.description: Physical print dimensions (5x7, a6, a5, letter, or square4). [Optional: omit to use server default filter].

prompt.description: Optional guest instruction paragraph shown above the QR code.

qr_style.description: QR module geometry (rounded, classic, or branded circular dots + accent finder eyes). [Optional: omit to use server default filter].

show_footer.description: Include the subtle GuestDrop credit footer (defaults to true).

show_steps.description: Include the 3-step guest scan instructions below the QR code (defaults to true).

theme.description: Visual theme palette and typography pairing. [Optional: omit to use server default filter].

name: generate_printable_qr_sign
title: Generate Printable Qr Sign
